FX-MREF-001.says: Matte Choker as added: stage 1 geometric softness 4, choke 75, gray level softness 10 per cent; stage 2 geometric softness 0, choke 0, gray level softness 100 per cent; one iteration. The rectangle is choked in from its edges and its corners rounded; the speck, the strands and the half-covered edge go; the hole at (11, 8) fills, in the orange about it.

FX-MREF-002.says: Matte Choker spreading then choking: stage 1 geometric softness 3, choke -60, gray level softness 20; stage 2 geometric softness 3, choke 60, gray level softness 20. The hole fills and the strands join, then the edges come back in.

FX-MREF-003.says: Matte Choker with both stages at geometric softness 0, choke 0, gray level softness 100: each pixel's disc is itself and the ramp runs 0 to 1, so the output is the drawing.

FX-MREF-004.says: Matte Choker, stage 1 geometric softness 2, choke 10, gray level softness 0: a hard step, every pixel covered in full where more than 54 per cent of its disc is covered and empty elsewhere.

FX-MREF-005.says: Matte Choker, stage 1 geometric softness 2, choke 0, gray level softness 100: the covering is the disc's average, a soft blur of the matte that spreads into the empty pixels round it.

FX-MREF-006.says: Matte Choker, stage 1 geometric softness 1.5, choke -40, gray level softness 50, three iterations: each pass spreads the matte further, though a lone corner can thin.

FX-MREF-007.says: Matte Choker, stage 1 choke keyed from -100 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4: frame 2 is choke 0.

FX-MREF-008.says: FX-MREF-001 moved three pixels right: worked in the drawing's own space, so the same, moved.

FX-MREF-009.says: Matte Choker, choke 1 at 128, above 127. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MREF-010.says: Matte Choker, gray level softness 2 at 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MREF-011.says: Matte Choker, iterations 0, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MREF-012.says: Matte Choker, geometric softness 1 at -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MREF-013.says: Refine Hard Matte as added: feather 2 pixels, contrast 50 per cent. The edge-aware filter softens the edges and contrast 50 steepens them again, so the rectangle stays nearly hard while the strands, the half-covered right edge and the speck change, and the hole at (11, 8) fills a little.

FX-MREF-014.says: Refine Hard Matte, feather 4, contrast 0: a wider, softer edge.

FX-MREF-015.says: FX-MREF-014 with shift edge 50: the edge moves out, more covering.

FX-MREF-016.says: FX-MREF-014 with shift edge -50: the edge moves in, less covering.

FX-MREF-017.says: Refine Hard Matte, feather 0, contrast 80: no filter, only the soft pixels steepened: the strands and the half-covered edge.

FX-MREF-018.says: Refine Hard Matte, feather 3, contrast 0, decontaminate on, amount 100, radius 2: each part-covered pixel's colour is pulled toward the colours of the covered pixels about it and away from those of the less covered ones; the covering is FX-MREF-014's at feather 3.

FX-MREF-019.says: FX-MREF-018 at amount 50: halfway, in linear light.

FX-MREF-020.says: FX-MREF-018 with View Decontamination Map: the layer opaque, grey where the colour is decontaminated, brightest at half covering.

FX-MREF-021.says: Refine Hard Matte, feather keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 6 at frame 4: feather is whole pixels, so frame 1 (1.5) is feather 1, frame 2 feather 3 and frame 3 (4.5) feather 4.

FX-MREF-023.says: Refine Soft Matte as added: edge radius 10, decontaminate on. Within 10 pixels of the matte's edge, on so small a drawing nearly all of it, the covering is fitted to the colours: the strands' covering follows their orange and teal rows, and the rectangle's teal ring and right side lose some; the colours are decontaminated.

FX-MREF-024.says: Refine Soft Matte, edge radius 4, View Edge Region: white where the edge region is, black elsewhere, the layer opaque.

FX-MREF-025.says: Refine Soft Matte, edge radius 4, feather 2, contrast 30, decontaminate off.

FX-MREF-026.says: Refine Soft Matte, edge radius 0, feather 0, contrast 0, decontaminate off: nothing to do, the output is the drawing.

FX-MREF-027.says: Refine Soft Matte, edge radius 4, shift edge 30, contrast 20, decontaminate on with radius 1, amount 70.

FX-MREF-028.says: Refine Hard Matte, feather 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MREF-029.says: Refine Hard Matte, contrast -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MREF-030.says: Refine Hard Matte, decontaminate written "yes". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MREF-031.says: Refine Hard Matte, shift edge 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MREF-032.says: Refine Hard Matte, decontamination radius -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MREF-033.says: Refine Soft Matte, edge radius 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MREF-034.says: Refine Soft Matte, view edge region written "maybe". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MREF-035.says: Refine Soft Matte, decontamination amount 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
